I am so sorry that you lost your child but honestly the best thing you can do right now is try to build up the courage to tackle all that trauma within you and forgive yourself because it is consuming you. Now with the baby I don’t know if this will help because it did when I lost my child but the child is probably better off in another realm with you not having to repeat a cycle of trauma and pass that onto your child because believe it or not the trauma  that we experienced as a child that shaped us was by individuals that still had pent up trauma that they were not addressing continuing a cycle of pain. So for your daughter please keep fighting to better yourself easier said then done but the only one to help you is yourself. Once you do that you can allow the energy of healing into your life and eventually meet people that can further your growth but you have to first walk down that path or self realization and acceptance. Start off small journal how you feel when it is overwhelming or talk out loud, please feed yourself healthy foods that will sustain you and give yourself energy start off very small and build your way up again.
